sentences.text: I'm Emily, and in today's episode, we are going to talk about something fun and exciting, the hair salon.
Going to the hair salon can be a little stressful if you don't know the right words, but don't worry.
In this episode, I'll teach you all the words and phrases you need to feel comfortable and confident when you visit the salon.
Whether you're getting a haircut, a color treatment, or just a blow dry, I will show you how to talk to your stylist in simple English.

In this episode, you'll learn basic vocabulary for the hair salon, how to tell the stylist what you want, common questions you'll hear at the salon, how to ask for different hairstyles, useful phrases to feel confident.
Key Hair Salon Vocabulary First, let's learn some important words that you will hear and use at the hair salon.
These words will help you understand what is happening and communicate with your stylist.
Salon tools and services, haircut, the act of cutting your hair to a new style, trim, a small cut to remove split ends and make your hair look neat, blow dry, drying your hair using a blow dryer.

Hair color, dyeing your hair to change its color, shampoo, a product used to wash your hair, conditioner, a product used to make your hair soft after shampooing, style the way your hair is cut or arranged, highlights, lighter strands of hair added to create a sun -kissed look.
Scalp Massage, a relaxing massage for your head while shampooing.
Salon Profes stylist, the person who cuts and styles your hair, colorist, a stylist who specializes in coloring hair, barber, a professional who cuts and styles men's hair.
Now that we know some important salon vocabulary, let's practice how to use these words and sentences.
One of the most important things when you go to the salon is telling your stylist what kind of haircut or style you want.
Here are some phrases to help you explain your preferences clearly.
If you want a haircut, I would like a haircut, please.
Can you trim my hair?
I want to keep my hair long, but I need a trim.
Please cut my hair a little shorter.
If you want a specific style or length, I want to keep my hair the same length.
Please cut my hair to my shoulders.
Can you make my hair shorter in the back, but leave it long in the front?
I want layers in my hair.
If you want hair color, I would like to change my hair color.
Can you give me highlights?
I want a full color, please.
Can you make my hair blonde?
Please add some red highlights.
If you want a style or blow dry, can you blow dry my hair straight?
I want beachy waves, please.
Can you curl my hair?
Please style my hair for a special event.
By using these simple phrases, you can tell your stylist exactly what you want.
